ttl.name: Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly (w/o Door)

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Wire Assembly

s2.ptxt: Connect the instrument panel wire assembly connector and lock it securely.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

s2.ptxt: Install the instrument panel passenger airbag assembly to the vehicle front wall of the airbag door with the 5 vehicle front side hooks.
Install the instrument panel passenger airbag assembly to the instrument panel upper with the 5 vehicle rear side hooks.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Upper w/ Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Engage the 5 claws.

atten3.ptxt: When installing the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly, work so as not to damage the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly and steering wheel assembly.

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 clips and 3 claws.
Connect the connectors.
Install the 2 instrument panel passenger airbag assembly installation bolts <A>.
Install the instrument panel UPR w/ instrument panel passenger airbag assembly with the 2 screws <B>.
Remove the protective tape that was applied.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Connector for Instrument Panel Passenger Airbag Assembly

s2.ptxt: Connect the instrument panel passenger airbag assembly connector.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Box Door Sub-assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Insert instrument panel box door No.1 in the direction of arrow (1).

atten3.ptxt: Make sure the area with protective tape does not interfere with instrument panel finish panel LWR No.1.

s2.ptxt: Insert instrument panel box door No.1 in the direction of arrow (2) so that the upper claws enter the inside of the instrument panel UPR.
Engage the 3 clips and 3 claws.
Install instrument panel box door No.1 with the 2 screws <B>.
Remove the protective tape that was applied.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Cluster Finish End Panel

s2.ptxt: Install the instrument cluster finish panel end.

s-1.ptxt: Install Glove Compartment Door Assembly

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws of the glove compartment door assembly hinge in the vehicle horizontal direction.

atten3.ptxt: Always install horizontally, as engaging from above causes looseness in the hinge.

s2.ptxt: Slightly deform parts A and B shown in the illustration in the direction of the arrows and engage the 2 stoppers.
Engage the claw, connect the glove compartment door stopper and install the glove compartment door assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Finish Panel Lower Center

s2.ptxt: Engage the 6 clips and 4 claws.
Install the instrument panel finish panel LWR CTR with the 2 screws <C>.

s-1.ptxt: Install Position Indicator Housing Assembly

s2.ptxt: Connect the connector.
Engage the 7 claws and install the position indicator housing assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Console Box Cover Rear
Install Shift Lever Knob

s2.ptxt: Turn the shift lever knob in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration to install it.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the protective cover.
Install a new front pillar garnish clip to the garnish.
Insert the guide at the front end.
Engage the front pillar garnish clip and clip, and install the front pillar garnish RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece RH

s2.ptxt: Insert the 2 guides B.
Engage the 5 claws and 2 guides A, and install the front pillar garnish corner piece RH.
Remove the protective tape that was applied.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish LH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece LH

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Register Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Connect the connector.
Engage the 2 clips, 5 claws and 3 guides, and install the instrument panel register assembly CTR.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Finish Panel End LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 clips and install the instrument panel finish panel end LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Combination Meter Assembly

s2.ptxt: Connect the connectors and temporarily install the combination meter assembly.

atten3.ptxt: When installing the combination meter assembly, be careful not to damage the instrument panel safety pad and combination meter assembly.

s2.ptxt: Install the combination meter assembly with the 4 screws.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Cluster Finish Panel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws and 9 clips, and install the instrument cluster finish panel.
Remove the protective tape that was applied.

s-1.ptxt: Install Instrument Panel Finish Panel End RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 clips and install the instrument panel finish panel end RH.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Battery Negative Terminal
Inspect Horn Button Assembly

s2.ptxt: Vehicles not involved in a collision

s3.ptxt: If any of the following applies, replace the horn button assembly with a new one.

specitem.ptxt: There are cracks, dents or chips on the pad surface of the horn button assembly

s2.ptxt: Vehicles involved in a collision in which the airbag did not deploy

atten2.ptxt: Replace the horn button assembly using the correct procedure.

s3.ptxt: Remove the horn button assembly, and if any of the following applies, replace the horn button assembly with a new one.

specitem.ptxt: There are cracks, dents or chips on the pad surface of the horn button assembly
There are scratches, cracks or damage on the connector and wire harness
The horn button assembly has been dropped

s3.ptxt: If any of the following applies, replace the horn button assembly and steering wheel assembly together with new ones.

specitem.ptxt: The horn button assembly interferes with the steering wheel assembly, making installation of the horn button assembly difficult
The clearance between the horn button assembly and steering wheel assembly when installed is not uniform
The bracket portion of the steering wheel assembly is deformed

atten3.ptxt: If the bracket portion of the steering wheel assembly is deformed, do not repair it; replace it with a new one.
